7. Saturday. Tone 6 [GY]. The Holy Council of Ephesus of the two hundred Patriarchs.
8. Sunday. Tone 7 [GK]. Sixth [Sunday]. Feast of the Announcement of the Fast of the Mother of God (Barekendan of the Fast of the Mother of God). Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [Py3]: "We glorify Thee." [Karr_avoremp]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [GK]: "The Divine Savior." [Zastvatsayin zger].
9. Monday. Tone 8 [DZ]. Fast of the Mother of God. Canticle [Harts] of penitence Tone 4 [By3]: "Who by Thy awesome."
15. Sunday. Tone 8 [DZ]. Assumption of the Holy Mother of God. The period of eating meat [midjots utikn] is three weeks. See the first volume, keeping the order of this place.

September

5. Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Fourth [Sunday]. Barekendan of the Fast of the Holy Cross. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [AK]: "Risen." [Harutsyal].
6. Monday. Tone 3 [BD]. Fast of the Holy Cross. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [By]: "The voice of the youths."
8. Wednesday. Tone 5 [GD]. Fast. Feast of the Birth of the Holy Virgin from Anna.
12. Sunday. Tone 5 [AD]. Exaltation of the Holy Cross. See the first volume, up to the eleventh Sunday, keeping the order of this place.
19. Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Second [Sunday]. Barekendan of Varag Holy Cross. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [DK]: "The choirs of angels." [Hreshtakatsn dask].
20. Monday. Tone 1 [AD]. Fast. Mamas, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]: "Who art exalted."
22. Wednesday. Tone 3 [BD]. Canticle [Harts] of penitence Tone 2 [By3]: "Blessed art Thou, Lord, and glorified."
26. Sunday. Tone 8 [DZ]. Third [Sunday]. Feast of Varag Holy Cross. The period of eating meat [midjots utikn] is eight weeks. See according to the order in the first [volume].

October

3. Sunday. Tone 7 [GK]. Fourth [Sunday]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [GK]: "Thy resurrection." [Zko yarutyund].
10. Sunday. Tone 6 [GY]. Fifth [Sunday]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [Gy3]: "Myrrh-bearing," [Yughaber] and "Today the resurrection," [Aysor yarutyun] and "By the sign of the cross." [I khachanish].
17. Sunday. Tone 4 [BK]. Sixth [Sunday]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [BK]: "Christ is risen," [Kristos yaryav] and "In the morning." [Aravotyan].
24. Sunday. Tone 3 [BD]. Seventh [Sunday]. Discovery of the Cross.
26. Tuesday. Tone 6 [GY]. Hyperichians. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]: "Holy God, creator."
27. Wednesday. Tone 7 [GK]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 7 [GK]: "God exalted."
31. Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Eighth [Sunday]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [AK]: "The wondrous angel." [Skancheli hreshtakn]. See also the others according to the order in the first volume.

November

7. Sunday. Tone 1 [AD]. Ninth [Sunday]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [AD]: "With the women," [End kanaysn] and "Who ineffable." [Or anchar].
14. Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Tenth [Sunday]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [DK]: "Thy angel, O Lord," [Hreshtak ko ter] to the end.
15. Monday. Tone 1 [AD]. Andrew the Commander, and Abasnak, etc.
16. Tuesday. Tone 2 [AK]. Adrian and his wife, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [Dy3]: "They who trusted."
17. Wednesday. Tone 3 [BD]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 8 [Dz]: "Blessed art Thou forever."
18. Thursday. Tone 4 [BK]. Abraham and Khoren, Cosmas and Damian, and Adeodatus [Astvadsatur] the martyr. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [By3]: "Holy art Thou, Lord of hosts."
20. Saturday. Tone 7 [GK]. All saints, old and new, known and unknown.
21. Sunday. Tone 8 [DZ]. Eleventh [Sunday]. Presentation of the Holy Mother of God. Barekendan of the Fasts of the Advent [Yisnakats].
22. Monday. Tone 8 [DK]. Fast of Advent. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [Dy3]: "Who in all things didst show."
28. Sunday. Tone 7 [GK]. First [Sunday of Advent]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [AK]: "Thy beginningless Word." [Anskizbn band]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [GK]: "Lamentation of our." [Arbal yev mer].
29. Monday. Tone 5 [DD]. Julian and Vasilouhi, and Indus and Domna, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 8 [DK]: "To Thee, O God." See also the others according to the order until the end in the first volume, keeping the order of this place.

December

1. Wednesday. Tone 1 [AD]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 7 [GK]: "God of our fathers, have mercy."
5. Sunday. Tone 6 [GY]. Second [Sunday of Advent]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [By3]: "Who art King." [Or tagavort es]. Processional [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [Gy3]: "Glorified is Thy." [Paravoryal e ko].
6. Monday. Tone 7 [GK]. Gennaro the Bishop, and Mercurius the Soldier, and Jacob [Yakovb] and Fravaphar [Iravapar].
